description:
`/work/hosts.json` is a JSON array of host names. Probe every host once with `health_probe` (`svc.healthProbe` in TypeScript).

Probes are slow, so run several at the same time, but never more than 3 at once. Give each probe at most 1 second by passing a 1-second timeout, and do not retry a probe. A host is up when its probe succeeds with `status` exactly `ok`. It is down when its probe fails for any reason, the timeout included, or reports any other status.

Print one JSON object to standard output: `{"up": [{"host": HOST, "version": VERSION}, ...], "down": [HOST, ...]}`, with both lists in the order of `hosts.json`. Exit with status 0.

Probe.doc: One host's health report. `status` is `ok`, `degraded`, or `draining`.

capabilities.description: Asks one host for its health report.
